<noinclude>赛季和活动默认使用游戏日程，可分别用同名参数覆盖。</noinclude><includeonly><div class="td2-home-panel td2-home-news td2-frame">{{TD2边框角节点}}
<h2>赛季信息</h2>
{{{赛季|{{#invoke:TD2首页赛季|render|时刻={{#time:U}}}}}}}
<p class="td2-home-empty">暂无赛季信息</p>
</div>
<div class="td2-home-panel td2-home-news td2-home-events td2-frame">{{TD2边框角节点}}
<h2>活动日程</h2>
{{{活动|{{#invoke:TD2首页活动|render|时刻={{#time:U}}}}}}}
<p class="td2-home-empty">暂无活动日程</p>
</div></includeonly>
